text:
Nina (People Ops): Quick micro-followup from the all-hands: posting a short thread for hybrid/office ops Qs (travel, offsites, desk booking, small reimbursements). Keep Qs short and we'll answer in thread.
Ava: For small team offsites (<20 ppl) we still get a travel stipend, right? how to request?
Nina (People Ops): Yes 10 10 $500 per person for small team offsites (under 50 people). Use Concur, tag with OPS_OFFSITE and attach the team attendee list.
Devin: If a spouse/partner comes because of childcare reasons, can we expense their flight?
Nina (People Ops): Generally no. Companion travel isn't covered unless pre-approved for safety/medical reasons. Speak to your manager & ops early; exceptions handled case-by-case.
Priya: Are meal per-diems different for international offsites?
Nina (People Ops): Yes 10 we use per diem caps by country. For standard short offsites, use the country-specific per diem in Concur. Ops will pre-fill rates for company-booked trips.
Marco: Desk hoteling 10 any tips when the portal shows no availability?
Nina (People Ops): Join the waitlist in the desk portal; we'll open overflow space in the Commons and convert meeting rooms if needed. If you're traveling for a booked customer meeting, mark it in the desk note & we'll prioritize.
Ava: If I ship my laptop to a hub for an on-site week, does ops cover courier?
Nina (People Ops): Yes, shipping company equipment between work locations is reimbursable. Code as EQUIPMENT_SHIP in Concur and include tracking.
Devin: COVID/health testing for international travel 10 still covered?
Nina (People Ops): If travel is company-directed (mandatory offsite or customer request), COVID tests and required health checks are reimbursable under HEALTH_TRAVEL. Voluntary travel = personal.
Priya: Parking at hubs 10 reimbursable for meetings?
Nina (People Ops): Yes 10 use LOCAL_PARKING. Daily commute parking not covered.
Marco: What about on-site childcare during a mandatory offsite day?
Nina (People Ops): We can reimburse reasonable childcare costs incurred specifically because of company-required travel. Get manager pre-approval and code as TRAVEL_CHILDCARE.
Ava: TL;DR of common expense codes?
Nina (People Ops): OPS_OFFSITE, HEALTH_TRAVEL, LOCAL_PARKING, EQUIPMENT_SHIP, TRAVEL_CHILDCARE, PER_DIEM, REMOTE_STIPEND. Put the code in Concur notes.
ops-bot: Note: People Ops will publish a one-pager with codes + desk booking tips and record a 3-min Loom. Calendar event created: "All-Hands Ops Followup: Hybrid & Travel".
Devin: Thanks! super helpful.
Nina (People Ops): I'll post the one-pager link here when ready. DM me if you need an exception fast.
Priya: Appreciated :)
